learning_objective: 🎯 We will have fun counting big numbers up to 50 and finding out which number is bigger!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Let us count together in tens! 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. We can count our blocks, crayons, and friends!
Number 40 has more things than 20. So, 40 is a bigger number! Just like a big elephant is bigger than a tiny mouse.
When we count forward, the numbers get bigger. After 29 comes 30. What comes after 45? It is 46!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Big Number Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your mummy or papa to write numbers 1 to 50 on small paper chits. Mix them up and pick the biggest number!

quick_recap: ⭐ We can count numbers jumping all the way to 50!
⭐ We know how to find the bigger and smaller numbers!
⭐ The hungry alligator mouth always eats the bigger number!
